Games can be patched, updated, and expanded much more easily now with the digital distribution... I remember occasionally I might find a patch or two for big titles installed from CD, but that was rare.

For better or worse, Overwatch (and games delivered like it) are able to have far more resources than games delivered entirely on disk and are much more likely to receive updates and fixes, and are able to receive them much more frequently.

For single-player games w/out online interaction, it's much less relevant. Overwatch's genre and content warrantsthis, IMO. For something that did not, look at EA's most recent SimCity.
